clock: document_date — supersession folds on document dates (the default; set `change.clock = "narrative"` for order within a work)
identity: organization → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
identity: party → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
identity: agreement → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
identity: defined_term → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
identity: case → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
question shapes: enumerate [organization, party, agreement, defined_term, case]; relations [cites]; events [(none)]; aggregate [(none — a claim type with a `ref` attribute can be counted by it)]
